eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 6:48 AM on AUG 27, 2025 Effective until 4:48 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix, Arizona.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Marjorie Ruth Dinsmore. She is described as a 94-year-old white female being approximately five feet two inches tall and weighs 115 pounds with brown hair and brown eyes. She was last seen on Tuesday, August 26, 2025, at 8:20 PM in the area of North 30th Drive and West Montecito Avenue on foot. She was wearing a green and blue striped shirt, jeans and unknown color/style shoes. Marjorie suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to become confused and easily lost. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
